pages.text: "I'll put them on myself!" Mina, a handspan shorter than Raju, spread trousers on the quilt. The river had fallen overnight; today everyone would fetch water. Raju, the experienced eldest, was dressed by the door.
Mina pushed both legs into one hole. Trying to stand, the legs could not spread. Thump onto the quilt! "Ouch! Raju, dress me!"
Raju started pulling the trousers. Mina hesitated. "No, I'll try once more." But both legs went into one hole again.
Mom sat on the quilt and laid the trousers neatly before Mina. "How many holes are here?"
Mina pointed. "One... two!" "How many legs do you have?" Mina looked down. "Two!"
"One Leg in Each Hole!" Mom held up two fingers. Mina repeated it, eyes shining.
Sitting, Mina pushed the right leg into one hole, then the left into the other. Feet came out of two holes!
Mina stood and pulled the trousers up. Mom asked Raju, "Who dressed Mina?" Raju smiled and shook their head. "Mina did it alone."
The next morning, Mina laid out the trousers, put in one leg at a time, and pulled them up. "I dressed myself again!"
Mom hugged Mina cheek to cheek. Mina smiled and wiggled a foot. "Let's go out together now!"
